reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes edge dislocations are more mobile than screw dislocations in BCC refractory alloys at high temperatures, contradicting well-established knowledge that screw dislocations control plasticity due to their lower mobility.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion based on yield strength plateau and dislocation character quantification.
reasons.usefulness: Despite being physically unsound, the hypothesis prompts a useful controlled experiment that could clarify strain-rate effects on dislocation mechanisms in refractory HEAs.
